results.title: DRC launches probe into illegal mining following massive copper and cobalt seizures
results.snippet:
Congo has intensified action against illegal mining in recent weeks, including suspending a key artisanal mining regulator and detaining hundreds of Chinese miners.

Chinese groups including CMOC and Zijin Mining account for much of Congo’s copper and cobalt production.
